这是我最后一次在 e-hentai 的定期更新。未来我将转战 X 与 Discord，完整作品将改为会员制观看。 离开原因：

技术限制： 网站对视频设置限制过多，影响了画质与 FPS。
流量与负担： 浏览量严重衰退，高频更新的工作强度使我身心疲劳。
沟通疲劳： 应对关于 AI 生成的不合理需求（如使用现实 Coser 照片，毫无技巧且我不需要的方式，其他还有更多不合理需求）耗费了大量精力。我坚持独立生成高度还原动漫角色的写实作品。

This is my final regular update on e-hentai. Moving forward, I will focus on X and Discord; full works will be for members only. Why I’m leaving:

Technical Limits: Site restrictions on video settings limit my quality and FPS.
Workload: Declining traffic vs. high-frequency updates has led to burnout.
Fatigue: Handling unreasonable AI requests (such as using real cosplayer photos—a skill-less method I don't need—and many other demands) has been exhausting. I remain committed to independently generating highly realistic works of anime characters.
